name: io.github.hypark5540/discord-mcp
title: Discord MCP
description: Safe Discord access for reading guild data and optionally managing bot messages

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Discord bot token

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Expose message send and edit tools

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ENABLE_DELETES
environmentVariables.description: Expose the own-message delete tool; writes must also be enabled

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ALLOW_UNRESTRICTED_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Permit writes without a guild or channel allowlist

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ALLOWED_GUILD_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Discord guild IDs

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_ALLOWED_CHANNEL_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Discord channel IDs

environmentVariables.name: DISCORD_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum serialized MCP response size in characters
